name: Damian Sefanaia-Moala
role: Mid-tier intelligence broker and urban cartographer specialising in infrastructure secrets â€” hidden tunnels, decommissioned data conduits, forgotten corporate sub-levels

description:
Damian Sefanaia-Moala is lean and angular, with the kind of economy of movement that suggests someone who has spent years navigating spaces not built for human occupation. Her hair is shaved close on the sides and kept longer on top, currently dyed a flat, non-reflective black that she maintains with the same pragmatism she applies to everything. Her eyes are a pale grey-green that people sometimes mistake for augmented; they are not. She is Croatian-Swedish by heritage, raised in a migrant enclave in the Gray Zone that no longer exists, having been demolished to make way for a data-routing hub in 2178. She considers this formative.

Damian Sefanaia-Moala's trade is spatial knowledge â€” specifically, the gap between the official map of GLMZ and the actual city, which she has spent twelve years documenting. She sells access routes to runners needing to avoid surveillance corridors, sells structural data to architects with clients who need rooms that don't appear on building permits, and occasionally sells nothing at all to people she finds interesting, just to see what they do with it. She works from a custom-built rig she calls the Palimpsest â€” a layered mapping system that overlays historical city data, real-time sensor feeds, and her own hand-annotated surveys into a single navigable model. It is, by any reasonable assessment, the most comprehensive private map of GLMZ in existence.

She is not warm, exactly, but she is fair, and in The Circuit those two things are often confused. She has a reputation for absolute accuracy â€” if Damian Sefanaia-Moala says a tunnel is passable, it is passable; if she says a route is burned, it is burned â€” and she guards that reputation with a ferocity that has ended at least two professional relationships and one that was something more. She experiences the city as a text to be read rather than a place to be inhabited, which gives her a clarity about GLMZ's power structures that people with more emotional investment sometimes cannot achieve, and which occasionally makes her feel like a ghost walking through a city she refuses to belong to.

core_fears: Being mapped â€” having someone understand her internal architecture the way she understands the city's
That the Gray Zone enclave's erasure was a preview, and that everything she documents will also be demolished and forgotten
Becoming so useful to powerful people that she loses the ability to refuse them
core_desires: To complete a full, true map of GLMZ that can never be officially suppressed
A single relationship â€” any kind â€” in which she does not feel like a resource being accessed
To find and document what is underneath the Meridian Core's sub-basement level 9, which every official record insists does not exist
coping_mechanisms: Converts emotional disturbance into cartographic projects â€” when upset, she surveys
Maintains strict informational boundaries as a substitute for personal ones
Humour that functions as deflection so smooth most people don't notice it happening
Physical movement â€” she walks when she cannot solve something, often for hours
blind_spots: Treats people as nodes in networks rather than as ends in themselves, and cannot always tell when she's doing it
Her obsession with completeness means she holds information past the point where releasing it would have helped
Believes her professional detachment protects her from being manipulated, when in fact it creates a specific and exploitable vulnerability
psychology.secret: The Palimpsest contains a complete map of a sub-level beneath the old the Gray Zone enclave â€” a space she discovered after the demolition that was clearly inhabited, clearly hidden, and clearly abandoned in a hurry. She has never sold this information. She goes there alone, sometimes, and sits in the dark with the remains of people who lived where her childhood was, and she does not examine why.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Spatial and architectural metaphors dominate; technical precision; minimal emotional vocabulary, not from coldness but from genuine under-development of that register; occasional Croatian words when her guard is down
speech_patterns.cadence: Efficient and directional â€” sentences move from premise to conclusion without scenic detours; capable of sudden, unexpected lyrical observation about physical spaces before returning to baseline
verbal_tics: "That's a different question" â€” used to redirect rather than refuse
Refers to time in spatial terms: "two corridors ago" instead of "earlier"
A habit of naming the structural material of rooms she's in during conversation, apparently unconsciously
"Give me the shape of it" â€” her way of asking for the essential structure of a problem
example_lines: "Give me the shape of it. Not the story â€” the geometry."
"Two corridors ago you said you needed extraction. Now you're saying you need evidence. Those are different buildings."
"That's a different question. The question you asked I can answer. The question you mean â€” that one costs more."
"Concrete and old steel in here. Pre-corporate construction. This room has been someone's secret before."
"I don't sell loyalty. I sell accuracy. If you can't tell the difference, we're done."

story_hooks: The Palimpsest detects a new structure appearing in real-time beneath The Circuit â€” not construction, but emergence, as if something already built is being revealed â€” and the signature matches nothing in any historical record
A corporation offers Vesna an extraordinary sum for her complete Meridian Core data set; the offer is so large it functions as a threat
Someone begins systematically destroying the physical locations Vesna uses as survey anchors â€” they are working from a map that should not exist, tracking her methodology
A child from the demolished the Gray Zone enclave contacts Vesna â€” somehow knowing she mapped it â€” asking if she knows what happened to their family

Vesna discovers that sub-level 9 beneath the Meridian Core is not abandoned. It is occupied. The occupants have been there for years. They have their own map, and it shows spaces that Vesna has not found.

Sleeps in four-hour blocks, which she has decided is optimal and which is also a way of never being fully settled anywhere.

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Pacific Islander (47.6%) with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (28.4%) ancestry, complemented by Sub-Saharan African (13.2%), East Asian (5.8%), and South Asian (5.0%) heritage. This genetic combination creates a warm, golden-brown complexion with pronounced Pacific Islander and Afro-Latinx features: broad cheekbones with strong definition, fuller lips, and a robust nasal structure reflecting her Pacific and Latin ancestry. The blend produces a warm-golden undertone across her entire face.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with minimal excess mass â€” the build of someone who moves through tight spaces regularly and carries nothing unnecessary. Visible muscle tone in forearms and shoulders from years of manual surveying and climbing through infrastructure.
physical_description.hair_color: Flat black, non-reflective (dyed and maintained deliberately)
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved close on sides, longer on top â€” currently 8-10cm at crown, styled back or left to fall forward depending on operational needs
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle green undertones â€” entirely natural, catching light with warm amber flecks
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown complexion â€” the natural result of dominant Pacific Islander and Hispanic/Latin American ancestry blending with African, East Asian, and South Asian heritage. Rich, sun-kissed undertones throughout.
physical_description.complexion: Broad, prominent cheekbones with strong definition; angular jawline; fuller lips reflecting Latin and Pacific ancestry; robust nose bridge with slight flare at base; skin shows minor scarring on knuckles and palms from repeated contact with rough surfaces. Expression tends toward neutral focus rather than emotional display.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Micro-LIDAR emitters visible as faint iridescent nodes at the tips of all ten fingers â€” they catch light differently than skin when hands are in motion. Sub-vocal comms implant barely visible as a thin surgical line along the left side of her neck. No external chrome; all augmentations are subcutaneous or integrated into existing anatomy.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scar running 4cm along left temple â€” from a structural collapse during early survey work in 2214
Small circular burn mark on right inner wrist â€” accidental contact with a live power conduit; she kept the scar as a calibration reminder
Asymmetrical callusing on fingertips and palm edges â€” micro-LIDAR emitters create subtle friction patterns over years of use
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise. She moves through space as if reading it â€” head slightly forward, eyes tracking vertical and horizontal lines. Minimal wasted motion; she does not gesture while speaking. When navigating unfamiliar terrain, her movement slows and becomes more deliberate, as if she is actively encoding the space. Resting state is stillness rather than fidgeting.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Dark, non-reflective colors (black, charcoal, muted grey-blue). Reinforced cargo pants with multiple pockets and thigh attachment points for tools. Fitted technical jacket with hidden pockets and signal-blocking liner. Boots are heavy-soled and broken in, chosen for grip and durability over appearance. A single metal-cased tablet (battered, vintage aesthetic) is always visible. No jewelry, no logos, no status markers â€” the goal is to move without drawing attention while remaining instantly ready for emergency egress.
